summaries.content: Software engineering student who ships full-stack products and applied AI features, with three internships behind her.

raw_achievements: Built a retrieval pipeline that answers support questions over 12,000 internal documents
Cut average answer latency from 4.2 s to 1.1 s with caching and batched embedding calls
Added an evaluation harness of 150 test questions that runs on every pull request
Built an internal scheduling dashboard used daily by a 25-person operations team
Reduced dashboard load time by 60% by paginating queries and adding database indexes
Wrote 80 integration tests that caught two regressions before release
Implemented 6 REST endpoints for a loyalty-card feature in a Spring Boot backend
Fixed 14 reported bugs across the checkout flow during a three-week sprint

projects.name: DocuAsk
projects.context: Question answering over PDF collections with cited answers.
raw_achievements: Built a RAG assistant that answers questions over PDF collections and cites the source page
Chunked and embedded 3,500 pages of documentation into a pgvector index
Scored 87% on a hand-labelled set of 120 questions using an automated evaluation script

projects.name: TrailTrack
projects.context: Full-stack hiking log with route statistics.
raw_achievements: Built a full-stack hiking log with GPX import, route statistics and elevation charts
Designed a typed REST API with 18 endpoints and request validation on every route
Deployed to the cloud with a CI pipeline that runs 45 tests on every push

projects.name: Queueless
projects.context: Appointment queue management for small clinics.
raw_achievements: Built an appointment queue for clinics with live position updates over WebSockets
Cut simulated waiting-room crowding by 30% in a pilot with 3 clinics
Containerised the stack with Docker so a new developer starts it with one command

projects.name: SignalWatch
raw_achievements: Trained an isolation-forest model that flags anomalies in server CPU and memory metrics
Reached 0.91 F1 on 6 months of labelled incident data from a public dataset
Packaged the detector as a Docker image that scores a metrics stream in real time

projects.name: MiniKV
projects.context: In-memory key-value store written for a systems course.
raw_achievements: Wrote an in-memory key-value store in Go with TTL expiry and an append-only log for recovery
Served 50,000 requests per second on a laptop in a load test with 100 concurrent clients
